title: Addition and Subtraction of 5-Digit Numbers
seo_title: Grade 5 Addition and Subtraction Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Add and subtract whole numbers of at least 5 digits; use techniques such as estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, rounding off and compensating, and addition and subtraction as inverse operations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 5 addition and subtraction worksheets: 5-digit column addition and subtraction, mental strategies, estimating, checking and word problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Line up the units; carry and borrow carefully.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers in columns with the units lined up.
  • Carry 1 to the next column when a column adds to 10 or more.
  • Borrow from the next column when the top digit is too small. Across a 0, borrow from the next place that is not 0.
  • Estimate first, and check subtraction with addition.

Examples

Example

60 204 − 27 586

borrow across the zeros

check: 32 618 + 27 586 = 60 204

Answer: 32 618

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting to carryWrite the carried 1 above the next column.
Borrowing across 0Go to the next place that is not 0.
Wrong columnsLine up the units.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 5 say about addition and subtraction?
faq.a: Add and subtract whole numbers of at least 5 digits, using estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, rounding off and compensating, and inverse operations.

faq.q: How do I check my answer?
faq.a: Estimate first, and use the inverse operation.
Exchanging 1 from the next place for 10 in this place.
So each digit is added to the same place.

items.e: 84 107 rounds to 84 000 and 46 782 rounds to 47 000. 84 000 − 47 000 = 37 000. The exact answer is 37 325, which is close to 37 000.

items.q: Round each number to the nearest ten thousand. Which is the best estimate for 436 820 + 285 370?
items.e: 436 820 rounds to 440 000 and 285 370 rounds to 290 000. 440 000 + 290 000 = 730 000. The exact answer is 722 190, which is close to 730 000.

items.q: Round each number to the nearest ten thousand. Which is the best estimate for 712 450 − 368 900?

items.q: Daniel worked out 72 315 − 38 742 = 43 573. Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate. Is his answer sensible?
items.e: Estimate: 72 000 − 39 000 = 33 000. Daniel's answer, 43 573, is about 10 000 bigger than the estimate. He exchanged 1 ten thousand for 10 thousands but did not change the 7 to 6. The correct answer is 33 573.

items.q: Priya worked out 63 857 + 24 968 = 88 825. Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate. Is her answer sensible?

items.q: Lethabo worked out 58 673 + 27 519 = 76 192. Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate. Is his answer sensible?

items.e: Step 1, after giving away: 64 005 − 8 368 = 55 637. Step 2, after buying: 55 637 + 5 275 = 60 912.

items.q: A warehouse had 125 400 parcels. It sent out 87 965 parcels, then a lorry delivered 46 580 more. How many parcels are in the warehouse now?
items.e: Step 1, after sending: 125 400 − 87 965 = 37 435. Step 2, after the delivery: 37 435 + 46 580 = 84 015.

items.q: Ashford has 74 385 people. Brookfield has 18 640 more people than Ashford. How many people live in the two towns altogether?
items.e: Step 1, people in Brookfield: 74 385 + 18 640 = 93 025. Step 2, both together: 74 385 + 93 025 = 167 410.

items.q: A website had 286 450 visitors in January and 315 780 visitors in February. Another website had 650 000 visitors in the same two months. How many more visitors did the other website have?
items.e: Step 1, visitors to the first website: 286 450 + 315 780 = 602 230. Step 2, find the difference: 650 000 − 602 230 = 47 770.

items.e: Step 1, fans on Saturday: 34 568 + 28 795 = 63 363. Step 2, find the difference: 72 000 − 63 363 = 8 637.

items.e: Step 1, 2 023 and 2 024: 12 486 km + 14 075 km = 26 561 km. Step 2, find the difference: 26 561 km − 11 938 km = 14 623 km.
